Preprocessing spatial data
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# Define the folder containing the xlsx files
folder_path <- "~/Downloads/Spatial_Gobbini/Fichier_results_lung predict/"

# Get all xlsx file names in the folder
xlsx_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to read sheet 2 from an xlsx file
read_sheet_2 <- function(file) {
  read_excel(file, sheet = 2) %>% 
    mutate(SourceFile = basename(file))  # Add file name as identifier
}

# Read all tables and combine them
combined_table <- map_dfr(xlsx_files, read_sheet_2)

# Format table
combined_table = combined_table %>%
  dplyr::select(-SourceFile) 

colnames(combined_table) = combined_table[1,]

combined_table = combined_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(`Slide ID` != "Slide ID") 
```

Processing of spatial data
```{r}
## Load clinical data
traitData = read.csv("../../LungPredict_DC_paper/input/raw_files/clinical_data_clean.csv")
## Extract patients with RNAseq
patients = traitData %>%
  filter(AN_clean != "") %>%
  pull(AN_clean)

data_spatial = list()
i = 1
for (x in unique(combined_table$`Tissue Category`)) {
  data_spatial[[i]] = combined_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(`Tissue Category` == x) %>% #Split by Tissue category (Stroma, Tumor, total)
    dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(.data$`Slide ID`, paste(patients, collapse = "|"))) %>% #Match with patients with RNAseq
    dplyr::mutate(PatientOrder = match(stringr::str_extract(.data$`Slide ID`, paste(patients, collapse = "|")), patients)) %>% #Extract the order of patients vector
    dplyr::arrange(PatientOrder) %>% #Match df with the corresponding order
    dplyr::select(-PatientOrder)# Remove temporary column
  
  names(data_spatial)[i] = x
    
  i = i + 1
}

# Subset to only patients with spatial data
patients = patients[which(patients%in%stringr::str_extract(data_spatial[[1]]$`Slide ID`, paste(patients, collapse = "|")))]

for (i in 1:length(data_spatial)) {
  data_spatial[[i]] = data_spatial[[i]] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Samples = patients) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("Samples") %>%
    dplyr::select(-`Slide ID`, -`Tissue Category`)
}

# Generate proportions of cells
for (i in 1:length(data_spatial)) {
  for(j in 1:nrow(data_spatial[[i]])){
    data_spatial[[i]][j,] = as.numeric(data_spatial[[i]][j,])/as.numeric(data_spatial[[i]]$`Total Cells`[j])
  }
  
  data_spatial[[i]] = data_spatial[[i]] %>%
    dplyr::select(-`Total Cells`)
}
```

Save spatial data
```{r}
save(data_spatial, file = "../input/Spatial_densities.RData")
```
